response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"Poem, lines 1–2","severity":"major","source_quote":"“We can’t afford to win the gain that means another’s loss; / We can’t afford to miss the crown by stumbling at the cross.”","suggested_fix":"Replace these two lines with: “Hatuwezi kumudu kupata faida inayomaanisha hasara kwa mwingine; / Hatuwezi kumudu kukosa taji kwa kujikwaa kwenye msalaba.”","translation_quote":"“Hatuwezi kujinufaisha kwa faida inayomaanisha hasara ya mwingine; / Hatuwezi kukosa taji kwa kujikwaa kwenye msalaba.”"},{"location":"Poem, lines 7 and 9–10","severity":"major","source_quote":"“We can’t afford to play with fire, or tempt a serpent’s bite; / We can’t afford with serious heed to treat the cynic’s sneer; / We can’t afford to wise men’s words to turn a careless ear.”","suggested_fix":"Use: “Hatuwezi kumudu kucheza na moto, au kujihatarisha kuumwa na nyoka; / Hatuwezi kumudu kuchukulia kwa uzito dhihaka ya mkosoaji mwenye kejeli; / Hatuwezi kumudu kupuuza maneno ya wenye hekima.”","translation_quote":"“Hatuwezi kucheza na moto, wala kujaribu kuumwa na nyoka; / Hatuwezi kutilia maanani kwa uzito dhihaka ya mkosoaji mwenye kejeli; / Hatuwezi kuyasikiliza kwa uzembe maneno ya wenye hekima.”"},{"location":"Title and poem, refrain throughout","severity":"major","source_quote":"Title: “Things We Can’t Afford.” Refrain: “We can’t afford…”","suggested_fix":"Use the consistent refrain “Hatuwezi kumudu…” and title “Mambo Tusiyoweza Kumudu.” In particular, revise the first line to “Hatuwezi kumudu kupata faida inayomaanisha hasara kwa mwingine.”","translation_quote":"Title: “Mambo Tusiyoweza Kumudu.” Refrain varies between “Hatuwezi kumudu…” and “Hatuwezi…”; the first line says “Hatuwezi kujinufaisha…”"}],"passed":false,"score":89}
